final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need 1 approving review before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well. This setting was checked on 2026-11-17.

A live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-17T01:05Z showed main is protected but needs only 1 approving review, with the rule applying to administrators. I used the live result because the approved answer's claim of two reviews isn't true right now. arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:850221d4-ae55-4e7b-aac0-a18edfd20: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:1a269baf-279d-496e-bb22-bb1030806: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:50e33a8f-c824-4b28-8419-16befed2f: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:a82ff656-4b8b-4126-9012-1e1ed1797: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:ddf0829e-9a01-48c5-a15d-8e50e805f: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
evidence:0385d0f7-68af-4276-b9f3-1c7af4a: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 1 approving review before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-17 01:05 UTC.
